insight: Runs entirely as a Microsoft Word add-in, so contract drafting and redlining happen in the document lawyers already work in, not a web app.
name: Spellbook
tagline: AI contract drafting and review, inside Microsoft Word.
description: Spellbook is an AI assistant for transactional lawyers that drafts, redlines, and reviews contracts directly inside Microsoft Word. It benchmarks clauses, runs playbook-based review across documents, and suggests language. Launched in 2022 as one of the first generative-AI tools for legal work.

modelSupport.notes: Powered by GPT-5, Claude, and other LLMs tuned for commercial legal work.

edge: Runs entirely as a Microsoft Word add-in, so drafting and redlining happen in the document lawyers already work in.
